name: Crimson Devotion
source:
Girl loser Choo Choo downloads an unsuspecting romance game; now she must chose between her real life relationships or the allure of a hot digital vampire. Although... it seems that there is a little more to the game than Choo Choo thought. 

[From [url=https://ghostleif.itch.io/crimson-devotion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女孩失败者Choo Choo下载了一款毫无戒心的浪漫游戏；现在，她必须在现实生活中的人际关系和炙手可热的数字吸血鬼的诱惑之间做出选择。虽然……游戏的内容似乎比Choo Choo想象的要多一些。

[来自[url=https://ghostleif.itch.io/crimson-devotion]itch.io[/url]]
